integrity: Analytic parameter-uniform proof, with separate symbolic and numerical reproduction; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact continuum result only for the three-dimensional axisymmetric Zernike span of radial orders 0, 2 and 4; fixed-area single concentric annuli. The off-center bound is an upper bound on least energy, not an equality away from the optimum. Historical equivalents in older polynomial-observability literature cannot be completely excluded.
title: Sharp fixed-area annular observation of the first three radial Zernike modes
